summary: 1. No new survey file (Day 18, which would reconcile July 12) has landed, and the Distance report, Equipment running hours workbook, and Grade Control workbook were not updated this pass. 2. Key operational findings: 1. 3. July 12 total production reached 23,126 BCM against a 23,469.2 BCM target — essentially flat (-1.5%), but the composition is unusual: ore beat its target by 279% (6,913 BCM vs 1,822.0 BCM), the largest ore beat of the July run, while waste missed by 25.1% (16,213 BCM vs 21,647.2 BCM), the deepest single-day waste shortfall of the month. 2. 4. MTD total sits at 374,697 BCM against a 387,242.4 BCM target — -3.2% vs target, narrowing slightly from July 11's -3.4% gap; MTD ore surplus jumped to +20.1% (from +3.4%) on the day's ore beat, while the MTD waste deficit widened to -5.2%. 3. 5. MTD crusher stockpile throughput reached 34,276.5 LCM against the 124,000 LCM monthly plan — 27.6% of plan, still well short of a linear day-18-of-30 pace (~60%). 6. Motor Grader daily availability crashed to 56.25%, the lowest single-fleet reading of the day — the fleet is a single unit (MG-266), and a new "Hyd Hose Leak" hydraulic breakdown (10.5 hrs, 7:00 AM-5:30 PM) took the whole category well under the report's 85% target line. 7. Two new major dump-truck faults: DT-108 ("Check Brake System, C/O Brake Pedal") ran 15.5 hrs down, 35.42% avail — the lowest single-truck reading of the day; DT-130 ("Tyre Puncture P-6") went fully Down, 0.00% avail, opened 5:30 AM, still no Date Out at report time. 8. DR-297 recovers: the drifter was replaced (2:00-5:00 PM planned stop), clearing the "Oil leaks" fault that had cut it to 56.25% avail on July 11 — this report shows 85.42% avail. 9. DR-343 remains down, now day 3 of its "Faulty Drifter" breakdown (opened July 11, 5:30 AM), still no Date Out — the longest-running open drill fault in the July dataset. Drilling missed its 2,722.0 m target for a second straight day (-10.3%), though fleet avail, utilization, and average penetration all recovered sharply from July 11's readings. EX-123 stayed down a seventh straight day ("L.H Track Off"). Two new excavator faults: EX-262 ("Check Grease System," 5 hrs) and EX-263 ("Noise From Engine Fan," 4 hrs, carrying into July 13). Overall fleet daily availability eased to 89.41% (MTD 91.65%), down from July 11's 91.52%. No new INX-SUM survey file has landed for Day 18 — the MTD survey gap headline in [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] still reflects Day 17 (through July 11, +0.97%). Following the KB's established 30-day production-month convention, July 12 is production day 18 of 30 — 12 days remaining. The "Weekly Plan WTD" line in the Client Meeting Report (131,068 BCM) did not reset to the daily total on what should be a new-week boundary — flagged as a possible data-lag artifact in the source workbook, not resolved this pass. Wiki updates: [[daily-production-report]] (Day 18 update section) and [[fleet-availability-utilization]] (July 12 Daily Availability Final Report section) updated; `Last updated` bumped to 2026-07-13 on both; `Wiki/INDEX.md` refreshed for the same two articles. Grade Control workbook not re-checked this pass (block-grid layout issue stands, unchanged since the 45th pass). Distance report and Equipment running hours not updated this pass. Workshop Daily Task 13-Jul-2026.pdf and the FCST 2-week forecast workbook (Week 29+30) registered at index level only, out of scope for this task. Full detail in `RAW/_INGESTED.md` under "55th compile pass."
